locations.note: The dream starts in Anacapri's Piazza Vittoria and mixes myth, literature and science fiction in a shifting reality.
A servant says Axel Munthe has walked to Torre La Guardia.
The player climbs the Phoenician Steps on the way across the island.
The player rides the chairlift up Monte Solaro.
The player reaches the Blue Grotto by way of the Damecuta ruins.
